vault_disambiguation.The Value Vault: The guide collection inside Skool, sold A LA CARTE to Standard members. Each guide carries its own price. A Standard member either buys individual guides, or pays Vault Unlock ($49 one-time) to take the whole vault. It is NOT included in the Standard tier. Never called 'PLR Vault' alone.
vault_disambiguation.The Premium Vault: The EXACT SAME guides as The Value Vault, every one already unlocked, included in Membership Premium at no extra cost. Nothing is bought a la carte at this tier. Formerly The VIP Vault.
vault_disambiguation.Pretty & Paid PLR Vault™: Separate $11/month Beacons subscription. Off-ladder. Never in a membership tier, never adjacent to Standard or Premium content, Wednesday promotion slot only.
vault_disambiguation.rule: Three distinct products. Never conflated, never renamed, never merged.
vault_disambiguation.value_vs_premium: The two vaults hold IDENTICAL contents. The only difference is how the member pays: Standard pays per guide (or $49 for the lot), Premium pays nothing further because it is already unlocked. This is the single most misstated fact in the brand.
banned_claims: The Value Vault is included in Standard
nothing extra to buy (attached to Standard)
any Standard inclusions list naming The Value Vault without stating it is a la carte
vault_disambiguation.banned_claims_note: These are FALSE STATEMENTS, not banned vocabulary. The rule is about what is asserted, not which words are used.
vault_disambiguation.bullet_rule: A bare bullet reading 'The Value Vault' inside a list of what Standard includes is a defect even where the page defines the vault correctly elsewhere. Write 'The Value Vault — guides a la carte' or do not list it.
vault_disambiguation.recorded: 2026-09-19, after two published Skool posts told Standard members the vault came free with their tier. Both corrected; one deleted.
vault_disambiguation.price_relationship_closed: Vault Unlock at $49 one-time sits above the $27/month Premium tier that already includes the same guides. Jodie knows; the vault is still being filled. Deliberate interim state, never raised as a defect, audit finding, pricing conflict or open item.

content_calendar_rules.vault_wednesday_only: Pretty & Paid PLR Vault™ promotes Wednesday only.
content_calendar_rules.never_adjacent: Vault and membership posts never share a day and never sit on adjacent days.
content_calendar_rules.meta: No income or earnings claims on Facebook or Instagram. Permitted on every other surface.
content_calendar_rules.registers: Skool community posts: warm, casual, emoji-forward, peer-to-peer. Site and editorial: luxury editorial. The two voices do not mix.
content_calendar_rules.rollout: Two-week rollout. Research starts at the beginning of the last week of the preceding month. One week of posts is released every 3–4 days across the last week of the preceding month and the first week of the covered month, each week tested and scheduled before it runs. Never promise the whole month before the 1st.
content_calendar_rules.purpose: The calendar organically promotes TDIE and its paid tiers. Anything inside TDIE is fair game. Every offer mention is a swap-in slot for the member's own offer; kept mentions pay the member via her Skool affiliate link (40%). Posting-day rules still apply.
